name: tw.com.ecpay.paymentgatewaykit.core.cvscode.CVSPaymentTransparentActivity
description: This ECPay (綠界科技) Payment Gateway SDK screen handles a convenience-store code or barcode payment in the SDK’s transparent window style. It displays the order payment instructions and returns the result to the app.
disableEffect: Convenience-store payment on this route may fail to open or return its result.
